purpose: Fresh recheck of the 153 English/Japanese sources excluded from the historical selection. Selection is not publication status: source frontmatter and the deployed revision determine retirement.
record_key: Exact repository source path; retirementEvidence uses an RFC6901 JSON Pointer into records. Every record inherits the policy, current search and engagement windows, attribution rules and limitations below.

policy.owner: Nibomo editorial policy, not a Google requirement
policy.age_basis: UTC audit date minus the later of declared publication date and first Git source appearance date, following verified renames. Git availability is not a proven deployment date.
policy.nominal_engagement_window: Latest 60 complete UTC days plus current partial-day positive vetoes; older activity expires as a veto. Attributed positive views anywhere within this range protect their actual page, including before the reliable-attribution baseline.
policy.negative_coverage: Use every expected complete day from the later of nominal start and the independently verified reliable URL-attribution baseline through yesterday. Disclose a shorter healthy warmup; never fabricate earlier zeros or advance the baseline to hide gaps.
policy.attribution_required: Unknown age or search data is not zero. Unattributed positive blog views, missing expected collection or attribution regressions within the reliable interval or current day block affected selections until resolved or outside the rolling window.
policy.pre_baseline_limit: Unattributed records before the reliable baseline remain measurement limitations and do not blanket-veto pages or locales. Any attributable early positive within the nominal range still vetoes its actual page.
policy.concrete_use_veto: Known backlinks, support obligations, seasonal or strategic uses veto selection. The fresh scoped audit records no concrete use veto for these 153 sources.
policy.selection_scope: Only the original 153 previously excluded sources, rechecked against the full current corpus; no unrelated newly eligible pages or restoration of historical retirements.

corpus_decisions.publication_truth: The cumulative count is conditional on shipping all 153 flags. The historical 655-record ledger remains immutable evidence of its earlier decision; current source flags determine publication status.

search.source: Successfully exported Google Search Console WEB URL aggregates, including anonymized queries; verified old/current domains and URL aliases aggregated by localized article without multiplying overlapping observations.
search.coverage_limit: Old property has all 60 dates. New property has Sep16-Oct17, starting before Sep18 08:23Z canonical migration; combined properties cover the active canonical-domain periods. New pre-export dates are unavailable, not observed zeros.
search.zero_rule: Missing URL rows count as zero only after establishing export completeness and localized identity/alias coverage.
search.job_metadata_limit: Query job ID and processed-byte count were unavailable.

collection_limits.limitation: No collection; not observed zero days.
Mixed instrumentation before the reliable baseline; attributed positives retained and unattributed positives recorded below.

engagement.baseline_reason: Verified initial path instrumentation Sep23 mixed history; first fully attributable complete UTC day Sep24. Baseline is not shifted to bypass gaps.

unassigned_positive_blog_views.interpretation: The 25 pre-baseline records are archived attribution limitations, not page-level zeros or blanket locale vetoes.

engagement.qualification: A page view belongs to a filtered engaged visitor UTC day with a page view and at least two qualifying site facts across the whole website, before filtering article paths. No article-local interaction is required; visitor-days are not unique people.
engagement.identified_day: Resolved actor identity with occurred_at UTC date.
engagement.cookieless_day: Daily visitor hash with server_received_at UTC date; first complete cohort day Sep23. Actor and hash cohorts are not merged.
engagement.exclusions: Current shared actor, admin, test, manual, automation, sandbox, bot, suspicious burst and materialized scraper-fleet exclusions are retained for the respective cohorts.
engagement.materialized_exclusions: Both expected classifications were populated; scheduled refresh succeeded at 2026-10-20T14:50:23.122Z before the current coverage query.
engagement.cookieless_exclusion_limit: Cookieless hashes have no actor; actor-based admin/test/manual exclusions cannot reach them, matching deployed contract.
engagement.url_attribution: Locale-stripped page_path is combined with ui_locale, normalized and joined through verified aliases. Missing or unknown locale/path is unassigned rather than English or zero.

instrumentation.limit: Old/new instrumentation overlapped; commit and observed event times do not prove deployment time or recover the older article paths.

engagement.passive_read_limit: The ten-second visible-time plus interaction signal first appears on Oct19. Earlier single-page readers without a second tracked fact cannot be reconstructed. Zero qualified use does not prove no readers.
engagement.negative_evidence_limit: 26 fully attributable complete days; Aug21-Sep21 have no collection and Sep22-Sep23 have mixed instrumentation, not fabricated zeros. All attributed positives Aug21-Oct20 veto actual pages.

provenance.metric_contract_parity: All six relevant source-contract files match current app main and deployed admin byte for byte; frozen source imports were used for the query.
provenance.candidate_source_identity: All 153 complete original source blobs and SHA256 hashes matched fresh selected evidence before adding exactly two frontmatter lines. All other source bytes are preserved.
provenance.source_date_provenance: Fresh source histories and publication metadata retain the verified first-source dates and rename identities for unchanged candidate source bytes.
